name: Intec Capital Limited
about: Intec Capital Limited, a non-banking financial company, provides loans to small and medium enterprises (SME) in India. The company offers business loans comprising unsecured loans to SMEs, corporates, and others; loans against collateral security of plant and machinery; and commercial loans, such as loans against property. It also provides collateral backed loans comprising mortgage of residential, commercial, industrial, and institutional properties. The company serves the auto and engineering, printing and packaging, plastic and injection molding, food processing, retailer, professional service, education, infrastructure, construction, chemical, leather, textile, metal, rubber, and capital goods and industrial equipment industries, as well as the pharmaceutical, medical, and healthcare industries. The company was formerly known as Intec Securities Ltd. and changed its name to Intec Capital Limited in September 2009. Intec Capital Limited was incorporated in 1994 and is based in New Delhi, India.
